findings.finding: Starting position, current position, qualification, and trajectory now require separate model-authored meanings and evidence roles. The observed missing-current-prose failure cannot conform to the v2 schema.

Every record must state the unresolved matter, preservation/reopen condition, and their relationship. Code correctly refuses to infer that two individually complete records should be semantically merged.

Prior frame, challenge, response, revision, and relationship are separately inspectable. A surface-order gate is rejected because reported and retrospective challenges can be semantically valid; source-first review remains mandatory.
Evidence schema, validation behavior, system prompt, and user prompt are byte-equivalent to the passing v1 reference.
All 60 prompts build, all 20 reviewed protected fixtures compile, and zero protected records quarantine. Maximum schema size is 2,145 bytes at depth 8; maximum user prompt is 6,537 bytes.
No deterministic semantic or temporal gate, semantic merge, global synthesis, evaluator, embedding, graph, or runtime behavior is added.

decision.reason: This is the smallest frozen packet reproducing the observed position failure: v1 cited starting, current, and qualification evidence but its generic prose described only the starting state.

nonclaims: Provider-free pass is not model-behavior evidence.
One position probe cannot establish uncertainty, challenge, transfer, stability, product value, or trust.
Role-explicit shape does not prove semantic role correctness.
